rules.description: Replay ledger events are read only through agenticx/runtime/replay_ledger/. Lines elsewhere that open events.jsonl by path bypass the store API. Literal patterns on purpose: studio_safety.py keeps a same-named safety audit log that is not a ledger read.
save_agent_state( is called only from agenticx/runtime/checkpoint.py; agenticx/studio/storage/ holds the interface and the backend implementations.

The ledger-projected resume anchor is entered only through load_resume_anchor, which keeps recovery layering (HA mode reads the checkpoint store) and the AGX_RESUME_FROM_LEDGER switch. A direct project_resume_anchor( call elsewhere skips both.

Dispatch mailbox and context snapshot files are read and written only through agenticx/runtime/subagent_runs/, which owns the per-root lock and the atomic writer. Lines elsewhere that open *.mailbox.json or *.context.json by path bypass that API. Baseline 0: no such literals exist outside the package at review time.

Replay ledger event rows are constructed only inside agenticx/runtime/replay_ledger/ (the recorder and the store own RunEvent). A RunEvent( literal elsewhere bypasses the recorder / harness event outlet and would append unnormalized rows. Baseline 0: no such literal exists outside the package at review time.
